name: Salman Rahman

short_bio: SQL Developer & Data Analyst specializing in Microsoft SQL Server, relational database architecture, Crystal Reports, and backend systems in C# and Python.
summary: Computer Science graduate with 4+ years of self-driven experience in SQL development, PL/SQL, data analysis, and IT support.

Experienced in working with Microsoft SQL Server and Crystal Reports to model enterprise data, build reliable queries, and deliver operational reporting, alongside foundational engineering skills in C# and Python.

Deeply interested in ERP systems, relational database architecture, backend development, data engineering, and product design, while continuously expanding technical depth through structured professional learning.

problem_solving_approach.description: Designing normalized relational schemas, explicit constraints, and deterministic audit trails in Microsoft SQL Server.
Transforming complex operational and transactional tables into clear, dependable Crystal Reports and analytical SQL datasets.
Building maintainable ERP workflows, APIs, and operational tooling with C# (.NET) and Python (FastAPI).
Applying CompTIA A+ certified diagnostics across workstations, ODBC connectivity, and enterprise infrastructure.
